title: Article 50 — Separation of judiciary from executive

content.overview: Article 50 directs the State to take steps to separate the judiciary from the executive in the public services of the State.
content.glance: State to separate the judiciary from the executive in the public services of the State.
content.study:
Article 50 is the separation-of-powers DPSP at the level of State public services (especially criminal magistracy). Many States have implemented separation of judicial and executive magistrates in stages.

Examination: separation of judiciary from executive; public services of the State.

sections.heading: Key directive
sections.body: Take steps to separate the judiciary from the executive in the public services of the State.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does Article 50 provide?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 50 directs the State to take steps to separate the judiciary from the executive in the public services of the State.

examTips: Separate judiciary from executive in State public services.

keyTakeaways: Art 50: separation of judiciary from executive.
